name: ServiceLaneRepairOrderManager
tagline: Run the whole dealer service lane – check-in to invoice – from one Power Apps component.
description: A complete repair order app for dealer service departments: live KPIs, RO register, workshop board, promise-time timeline and an additional-work approvals desk, with status rules for check-in, technicians, parts, approvals, quality check and invoicing. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: 8 service KPIs incl. overdue and at-risk promises
Bulk status, technician assignment, notify ready, CSV export
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field)
